about_me.title: About Me
about_me.text1: Hi, I'm Nurzhanat Zhussup, a passionate software engineer and data scientist with a deep curiosity for technology. I'm {{age}} years old and born in Almaty, Kazakhstan 🇰🇿⛰️
about_me.text2: I am currently based in Vienna, Austria 🇦🇹. I hold a degree in Economics from WU Vienna, which initially steered me towards a career in finance or the economics field. However, after taking a data science specialization, I discovered my love for coding. As I explored more of the tech world, my passion for programming grew stronger. I then realized that I truly wanted to be in the tech industry, which sparked my transition into software engineering. Since then, I have gained extensive skills in web development, focusing on both frontend and backend technologies. Additionally, with my specialization in data science, I possess strong knowledge of Machine Learning and Data Engineering. So, briefly speaking, I am just a guy who enjoys building things and learning something new. :)

hobbies.title: Hobbies
hobbies.text1: I absolutely love skiing ⛷️, and it's probably on the same level as coding for me, as I can't imagine my life without these two. :) In addition to skiing, I enjoy playing tennis and hiking. I also frequently watch Udemy courses as part of my self-development. Additionally, I like spending my time reading tech books to further expand my knowledge. Outside of these activities, I stay curious about the latest trends in technology and continuously seek new ways to improve both professionally and personally. Whether it's tackling a coding challenge or exploring the outdoors, I'm always looking for new experiences to grow and learn.

links.title: Links
links.text1: Either on the left side or above (depending on the device you're reading this on), you can find the most important links to get to know me better. I would highly encourage you to check out the projects section, where you can find the projects I am most proud of. Also, if you're interested, there is a CV section you can check out as well.
links.text2: It was a pleasure sharing a bit about myself with you! :) I hope you enjoyed my little story. Hit these little LinkedIn or Email icons in the footer section to stay connected 🚀

beyond.title: Beyond the screen
beyond.text1: I’m naturally curious, both in my work and outside it. I like understanding how things fit together, whether that means tracing a problem through a software system or finding a new route through the mountains. I value calm thinking, honest conversations, and doing things with care.
beyond.text2: Time outdoors gives me the space to reset. Skiing, hiking, travelling, and photography pull me away from the screen and into the moment. They keep me patient, observant, and comfortable with taking the longer path when it leads somewhere more interesting.
